page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin beside lines 1–3 and 4–6 of the first paragraph, with one note at line 3. Running head top centre with page number 137 at the top right of the text block. A catchword at the foot right. The stamp-like "124" in the top right corner is outside the printed page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: legalis Pontificis, cum Sacerdote nostro Jesu Christo, 1. Docent: Sicut cō-riorum in-terpretatio-nestat, victimas legales nullam divinæ justitiæ satisfaciendi vim habuisse: sic nec Pontificis personam, præsertim cum sacrificiorum vis in victima potius, quàm in Sacerdote residere videatur: immò ad ipsam satisfactionem peragendam, Sacerdotis personam nihil ꝑ[?]sus momenti afferre posse.

2. Cùm dicitur in Levitico: Et expiabit eum Sacerdos à peccato, & remittetur ei, docent, hoc nihil aliud esse, quàm peracto sacrificio illo, Sacerdotem liberaturum esse illum à noxâ, non quidem Deo satisfaciendo, aut propter dignitate, vel suam, vel ipsius Sacrificii, Deum ad liberationem ejusmodi concedendam inducendo: sed in peragedo, quod pro illo peragi voluit Deus, ut is delicti sui veniam consequeretur: & propter Dei spontaneam & puram benignitatem, qui eo sacrificio peracto, illum coram se mundum ab eo peccato fore decreverat, Et sic Expiare & Mundare significare ajunt, Expiatum & Mundatum

page.notes: The first word "legalis" is a fragment continued from the previous page. "ꝑ[?]sus" is uncertain: the printed form appears as "prsus" with a p-abbreviation mark; likely "prorsus" with the "o" lost in printing, but not legible enough to correct. Marginal note at the right is read as "riorum in-terpretatio-ne"; the words are partly cut at the edge and the note starts mid-word. A small reference mark appears by the marginal note at line 3 and is not otherwise tied to a mark in the text. The gathering signature "I s" is uncertain (the final letter may be a long s or f). The page-number-like "124" in the top right corner appears to be a later number and is not printed on the page.
